historical_validation.source: Chronological pregame score; outcome revealed only after the prediction

week_five.note: Model trained through first five published game dates; current-season follow-up is sparse and retrospective.

cross_night.note: This sample does not establish cross-night competitive difficulty or verify same-person identity.

whole_division.method: Expected mismatch across every possible within-division pairing, not just the two moving clubs.

constraints: Current 2026 evaluation is retrospective, not an untouched prospective test.
Historical registration and game sheet source pages are not signed game-day attendance records.
No full future schedule, facility-authorized available ice, referee allocations or age eligibility connected.
Models never compare disconnected result graphs or unrelated program families.
Player same-ID cross-night overlap does not imply verified identity or calibrated competition differences.
Source team names, registered rosters and scoring are snapshots with uncertain historical coverage.
All commissioner decisions and actual changes remain outside this demonstration.

observed_match_disparity.explanation: Historical prediction of five-goal score margins improves only marginally; three-goal margin calibration does not outperform a neutral rate. A goal-margin threshold is not a player-safety event or discipline finding.
